heading.zh-Hant: 出身、工程師與戰前軍職
heading.en: Origins, engineering career and pre-war service

body.zh-Hant: 據澳洲帝國軍專案頁（羅斯·馬利特撰），約翰·莫納什生於1865年6月27日，出生地為墨爾本，是普魯士猶太裔移民家庭的長子。他1893年取得墨爾本大學工程碩士，1895年取得文學士與法學士，後來成為成功的土木工程師，1912年當選維多利亞工程師學會會長。他同時擔任預備役軍人，1908年3月以少校身分被點名指揮新成立的澳洲情報軍團維多利亞分部，並授中校銜；1913年6月21日升為正式上校，並受命指揮第13步兵旅。
body.en: Per the AIF Project page (by Ross Mallett), John Monash was born on 27 June 1865 in Melbourne, the eldest child of immigrants of Prussian-Jewish origin. He took a Master of Engineering at the University of Melbourne in 1893 and a BA and LLB in 1895, became a successful civil engineer, and was elected President of the Victorian Institute of Engineers in 1912. He served as a part-time soldier as well: in March 1908, still a major, he was chosen to command the Victorian Section of the newly formed Australian Intelligence Corps with the rank of lieutenant colonel, and on 21 June 1913 he was promoted to full colonel and given command of the 13th Infantry Brigade.

heading.en: The 4th Brigade and Gallipoli

body.zh-Hant: 1914年9月15日，莫納什受命指揮新成立的澳洲帝國軍第4步兵旅。該旅1915年4月25日傍晚開始在安扎克灣登陸，所守陣地後方的山谷後來被稱為「莫納什谷」。8月攻勢中，該旅被交付迂迴土耳其側翼、從後方奪取971高地的艱難任務，行動未能成功，來源稱此役在他作為指揮官的聲譽上留下污點。他在1916年7月13日卸下旅長職務並晉升少將。
body.en: On 15 September 1914 Monash was appointed to command the newly formed 4th Infantry Brigade of the AIF. The brigade began landing at Anzac Cove on the evening of 25 April 1915, and the valley behind its positions became known as Monash Valley. In the August offensive the brigade was given the difficult task of slipping around the Turkish flank and capturing Hill 971 from behind; the operation miscarried and, the source says, left a black mark on Monash's reputation as a commander. On 13 July 1916 he relinquished command and was promoted to major general.

heading.zh-Hant: 第3師與梅西訪、布勞德塞恩
heading.en: The 3rd Division at Messines and Broodeseinde

body.zh-Hant: 莫納什晉升少將後統率第3師，1916年11月21日該師移往法國。1917年6月7日第3師在梅西訪發動首次大規模攻擊，奪取全部目標；英國遠征軍總司令黑格評他是「頭腦清楚、果斷的指揮官」。該師1917年10月4日投入布勞德塞恩之役；10月12日的另一次進攻失敗，來源稱該役是一場慘敗。1917年11月15日，第3師編入伯德伍德的澳洲軍團。1918年5月31日他接掌澳洲軍團。
body.en: After his promotion Monash led the 3rd Division, which moved to France on 21 November 1916. The division made its first major attack at Messines on 7 June 1917 and captured all its objectives; the BEF's commander-in-chief, Haig, described Monash as "a clear headed and determined commander". The division entered the Battle of Broodeseinde on 4 October 1917; another attack on 12 October miscarried, and the source calls the battle a debacle. On 15 November 1917 the division became part of Birdwood's Australian Corps, and on 31 May 1918 Monash assumed command of that corps.

heading.en: Commander of the Australian Corps and Amiens

body.zh-Hant: 莫納什1918年5月31日接掌澳洲軍團並晉升中將；該軍團兵力16萬6千人，是英國遠征軍20個軍團中最大的一個。他任軍團司令的第一場戰役是規模不大的哈梅爾之役，取得輝煌成功；接著1918年8月8日在亞眠發動更大的攻勢。其後軍團在聖康坦山與佩羅訥獲勝，迫使德軍退向興登堡防線。1918年11月21日他離開軍團，轉任遣返事務總監。
body.en: On 31 May 1918 Monash assumed command of the Australian Corps and was promoted to lieutenant general; with 166,000 men it was the largest of the 20 corps in the BEF. His first battle as corps commander was the minor one at Hamel, a spectacular success, followed by a larger attack at Amiens on 8 August 1918. The corps then won victories at Mont St Quentin and Peronne, forcing the Germans back toward the Hindenburg Line. On 21 November 1918 he left the corps to become Director General of Repatriation.

heading.zh-Hant: 第3師、澳洲軍團與哈梅爾
heading.en: The 3rd Division, the Australian Corps and Hamel

body.zh-Hant: 澳洲戰爭紀念館稱，加里波利戰役之後，莫納什升任新成立的澳洲第3師師長；該師1917年參與梅西訥與帕斯尚爾攻勢的戰鬥，1918年初在索姆河一帶面對德軍。同館稱1918年6月他晉升中將並受命指揮澳洲軍團，此後率部取得一連串勝利，直到大戰結束。約翰·莫納什中心（澳洲退伍軍人事務部）的簡介則稱，許多人視1918年7月4日的哈梅爾戰役為他聲名大振的時刻，其後有舒涅、聖康坦山與佩羅訥等一連串勝利。
body.en: The Australian War Memorial says that after Gallipoli Monash was promoted to command the new 3rd Australian Division, which fought at Messines and in the Passchendaele offensive in 1917 and faced the Germans on the Somme in early 1918. It says he was promoted lieutenant-general in June 1918 and appointed to command the Australian Corps, leading it through a series of victories to the end of the war. The Sir John Monash Centre (Australian Department of Veterans' Affairs) profile adds that many regarded the Battle of Hamel (4 July 1918) as his finest hour, followed by victories at Chuignes, Mont Saint-Quentin and Péronne.

heading.en: Origins and early naval career

body.zh-Hant: 據澳洲戰爭紀念館人物頁，約翰·喀瑞斯生於2月6日，出生地在後來成為坎培拉的貢加林一帶；同館另一頁寫明他生於1887年。他先在帕拉馬塔的國王學校就讀，後在英國完成學業，1902年5月進入英國皇家海軍的訓練艦不列顛尼亞號。他早年專攻魚雷，並多次調回澳洲任職。1913年1月26日他加入澳洲皇家海軍。
body.en: According to the Australian War Memorial people page, John Crace was born on 6 February in the area of New South Wales that later became Gungahlin; another page of the Memorial gives the year as 1887. He began school at the Kings School at Parramatta, completed his education in England, and joined the Royal Navy's training ship HMS Britannia in May 1902. In his first decade he specialised as a torpedo officer and returned to Australia several times on postings. On 26 January 1913 he joined the Royal Australian Navy.

heading.en: The Australian Squadron and the Coral Sea

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月前，喀瑞斯已晉升少將並受命指揮澳洲艦隊（紀念館年表記為1939年7月）。到任後他發現澳洲大部分艦艇都在遠離本土的海域作戰，因此滿腹挫折。對日戰爭爆發後，他出任盟軍海軍中隊——澳紐軍團部隊的司令，在新幾內亞周邊海域行動，並抱怨自己的艦艇只獲次要角色。1942年5月他參與珊瑚海海戰，但位置偏離主戰場；紀念館另頁寫明他的第44特遣艦隊奉命阻止日軍進犯莫士比港，並成功。1942年6月他交卸指揮並返回英國。
body.en: By September 1939 Crace had been promoted to rear admiral and appointed to command the Australian Squadron (the Memorial's chronology dates this to July 1939). On arriving he found that most of Australia's naval vessels were operating far from Australian shores and was frustrated. When the war against Japan began he became commander of the Allied Naval Squadron, ANZAC Force, operating in the waters around New Guinea, and was unhappy that his ships were given a minor role. He served at the Battle of the Coral Sea in May 1942 in a position peripheral to the main action; another Memorial page says his Task Force 44 was deployed to block the Japanese from invading Port Moresby, and succeeded. In June 1942 he returned to England having handed over his command.

heading.en: Chatham Dockyard and later life

body.zh-Hant: 回到英國後，喀瑞斯出任查坦海軍船塢總監，任職到1946年7月。他退休後住在漢普郡，於1968年5月11日去世。紀念館另頁稱他在1942年是第一位統率澳美聯合特遣艦隊的澳洲人。
body.en: Back in England Crace became Superintendent of Chatham Naval Dockyard, holding the position until July 1946. He retired to Hampshire, where he died on 11 May 1968. Another Memorial page calls him, in 1942, the first Australian to command a joint Australian–American task force.

body.zh-Hant: 澳洲戰爭紀念館的珊瑚海海戰條目稱，由重巡洋艦澳大利亞號與輕巡洋艦荷巴特號組成的第44特遣艦隊，在海軍少將克雷斯（J. G. Crace，英國皇家海軍）指揮下自雪梨出航。5月7日上午，美軍特混艦隊指揮官把克雷斯的支援群分出，改稱第17.3特遣群，派往新幾內亞方向；其任務是阻止任何日軍從喬馬德水道進入珊瑚海。史家里卡德（John Rickard）則寫道，這些艦艇在5月5日成為第17.3特遣隊。
body.en: The Australian War Memorial's Coral Sea entry says Task Force 44, made up of the heavy cruiser HMAS Australia and the light cruiser HMAS Hobart, departed Sydney under Rear Admiral J. G. Crace, RN. On the morning of 7 May he detached Crace's Support Group, redesignated Task Group 17.3, towards New Guinea; its mission was to prevent any Japanese force debouching from the Jomard Passage into the Coral Sea. The historian John Rickard writes instead that these ships became Task Force 17.3 on 5 May.

heading.en: Origins and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 據澳洲戰爭紀念館人物頁，萊斯里·莫希德1889年9月18日生於維多利亞州巴拉瑞特，原為教師。他1914年9月以中尉身分加入澳洲帝國軍，1915年4月25日登陸加里波利，8月在洛恩派恩作戰。其後他升中校並指揮第33營，營在1916年11月抵達法國；他率營打過梅西訪與帕森達勒戰役，獲頒傑出服務勛章，並在1918年的維萊—布勒托訥與亞眠等戰役中繼續指揮。1919年12月他返回雪梨。
body.en: Per the Australian War Memorial's people page, Leslie Morshead was born at Ballarat, Victoria, on 18 September 1889 and became a teacher. He joined the AIF in September 1914 as a lieutenant, landed at Gallipoli on 25 April 1915 and fought at Lone Pine in August. Promoted lieutenant colonel, he commanded the 33rd Battalion, which reached France in November 1916; he led it through Messines and Passchendaele, was awarded the Distinguished Service Order, and continued to command through Villers-Bretonneux and Amiens in 1918. He returned to Sydney in December 1919.

heading.en: Interwar years, the 18th Brigade and the 9th Division

body.zh-Hant: 戰後莫希德重回雪梨航運業，並仍活躍於民兵，指揮過兩個營，官至代理准將。1939年10月，他受命指揮第2澳洲帝國軍第18旅，1940年5月啟程赴英國。1941年2月，他晉升少將，出任當時駐中東的第9師師長。
body.en: After the war Morshead returned to work in shipping in Sydney and stayed active in the militia, commanding two battalions and reaching the rank of temporary brigadier. In October 1939 he enlisted in the 2nd AIF and was given command of the 18th Brigade, sailing for Britain in May 1940. In February 1941 he was promoted to major general in command of the 9th Division, then in the Middle East.

heading.zh-Hant: 托布魯克、阿拉曼與新幾內亞
heading.en: Tobruk, El Alamein and New Guinea

body.zh-Hant: 莫希德率第9師打過托布魯克圍城，他的積極防禦讓德軍無法突破。托布魯克之功使他晉升中將，並指揮中東的澳洲帝國軍。他堅持第9師不被拆散，並率該師參加阿拉曼戰役，來源稱該師的貢獻對勝利至關重要。1943年返澳後，他於10月接掌第2軍，11月升任新幾內亞部隊與澳洲第2軍團司令；1944年5月改領第1軍，率其打完婆羅洲的最後戰役。
body.en: Morshead led the 9th Division through the siege of Tobruk, where his aggressive defence denied the Germans a breakthrough. His success there was followed by promotion to lieutenant general and command of the AIF in the Middle East. He argued to keep the 9th Division together and led it through the battle of El Alamein, where its contribution was considered vital to the victory. Returning to Australia in 1943, he took command of II Corps in October, was elevated in November to command both New Guinea Force and the Second Australian Army, and in May 1944 was given command of I Corps, leading it through the final battles of the war in Borneo.

heading.en: The fortress of Tobruk

body.zh-Hant: 澳洲戰爭紀念館稱，1941年4月至8月間約1.4萬名澳洲兵被隆美爾指揮的德義聯軍圍困於托布魯克，守軍由莫希德指揮，包括第9師與第7師第18旅。該館刊物寫道，第9師師長莫希德接替拉瓦拉克成為要塞指揮官；檔案指南則稱他守住要塞直到1941年10月獲得替換，堅守使軸心國得不到急欲取得的港口。托布魯克之鼠協會（具名協會）引述他對部下所說：「這裡不會有敦克爾克。」
body.en: The Australian War Memorial says that between April and August 1941 around 14,000 Australians were besieged in Tobruk by a German-Italian army under Rommel, the garrison being commanded by Morshead and including the 9th Division and the 7th Division's 18th Brigade. A Memorial magazine article says the 9th Division's Morshead became fortress commander, taking over from John Lavarack; its finding aid says he held the fortress until relieved in October 1941, denying the Axis the port it badly wanted. The Rats of Tobruk Association quotes him telling his men: 'There will be no Dunkirk here.'

heading.en: The 18th Brigade in England and the 9th Division

body.zh-Hant: 澳洲戰爭紀念館檔案指南稱，莫希德在二戰爆發後受任於第二澳洲帝國軍並指揮第18旅；該旅1940年5月先被派往英國，待德軍入侵威脅過去。1941年1月他獲頒CBE並調往中東，2月升任准將並指揮第9師。
body.en: The Australian War Memorial's finding aid says that after the outbreak of the Second World War Morshead joined the Second AIF and commanded the 18th Brigade, which was first sent to England in May 1940. By January 1941 he had been appointed CBE and moved to the Middle East, and in February he was given command of the 9th Division.

heading.en: Post-war career and death

body.zh-Hant: 據澳洲戰爭紀念館檔案指南，戰爭結束後莫希德立即主持調查馬來亞戰役與新加坡失陷的軍事調查庭；他拒絕軍職與外交職位的邀請，回到東方輪船公司，1948年出任澳洲區總經理。1957年他受命主持檢討國防部組織與運作的委員會，隨後因癌症健康惡化，1959年9月26日逝世。
body.en: According to the Australian War Memorial's finding aid, immediately after the war Morshead chaired a court of inquiry into the Malayan campaign and the fall of Singapore; declining military and diplomatic posts, he returned to the Orient Line, becoming Australian General Manager in 1948. In 1957 he was appointed to chair a committee reviewing the Defence Department, and he died on 26 September 1959.

body.zh-Hant: 據約翰·里卡德撰寫的戰史網站條目，亞瑟·科寧漢1895年1月19日生於澳洲布里斯本，不久後父母遷居紐西蘭，他在惠靈頓學院受教育。1914年他加入坎特伯里騎兵步槍隊，參與占領德屬薩摩亞與加里波利戰役。1916年8月轉入皇家飛行隊，同年12月到西線，在第32中隊當戰鬥機飛行員，並獲頒DSO與MC。其後他回到法國，出任第92中隊隊長，並獲DFC。
body.en: According to the war-history site entry by John Rickard, Arthur Coningham was born in Brisbane, Australia, on 19 January 1895; his parents soon moved to New Zealand and he was educated at Wellington College. In 1914 he joined the Canterbury Mounted Rifles and took part in the occupation of German-held Samoa and in the Gallipoli campaign. In August 1916 he transferred to the Royal Flying Corps and in December moved to the Western Front as a fighter pilot with No. 32 Squadron, winning the DSO and MC. He later returned to France as commander of No. 92 Squadron and won the DFC.

heading.en: The Desert Air Force and El Alamein

body.zh-Hant: 1941年，科寧漢受命指揮西部沙漠的沙漠空軍並晉升空軍少將，在此發展陸空協同理論。沙漠空軍在阻止隆美爾最後攻勢與第二次阿拉曼戰役的勝利中扮演關鍵角色，他因此在1942年11月4日受封爵士。他繼續以沙漠空軍司令身分支援第八集團軍，直到蒙哥馬利1943年1月23日占領的黎波里。1943年2月他轉任第1盟軍（北非）戰術空軍司令。
body.en: In 1941 Coningham was given command of the Desert Air Force in the Western Desert and promoted to Air Vice Marshal, where he developed his theories of army–air force cooperation. The Desert Air Force played a critical part in stopping Rommel's last offensives and in the victory at the second battle of El Alamein, for which he was knighted on 4 November 1942. He continued to support the Eighth Army as commander of the Desert Air Force until Montgomery occupied Tripoli on 23 January 1943, and in February 1943 took command of the 1st Allied (North African) Tactical Air Force.

heading.en: Origins, the First World War and the interwar years

body.zh-Hant: 據歷史網路雜誌《History Is Now》馬諾利斯·佩波納斯所撰文章，伯納德·弗賴伯格1889年生於倫敦，1891年隨父母遷居紐西蘭，年輕時以游泳聞名。1914年3月他前往美國，再到墨西哥參與墨西哥革命，同年夏天得知一戰爆發後投入英軍。他在西線與加里波利作戰，受傷九次；1915年4月因泅水上岸牽制土耳其軍而獲DSO，1916年因索姆河戰役中的英勇行為獲維多利亞十字勳章。戰間期他多任幕僚職，1937年因心臟問題被迫退役。
body.en: According to an article by Manolis Peponas in History Is Now magazine, Bernard Freyberg was born in London in 1889 and moved to New Zealand with his parents in 1891, becoming famous as a young swimmer. In March 1914 he moved to the USA and then to Mexico, where he took part in the Mexican Revolution, and in summer 1914, on learning that the First World War had begun, he enlisted in the British Army. He fought on the Western Front and at Gallipoli and was wounded nine times; he won the DSO in April 1915 for swimming ashore to divert Turkish attention, and the Victoria Cross in 1916 for his actions at the Somme. In the interwar period he worked mainly in staff positions and in 1937 was obliged to retire because of a heart problem.

heading.en: The 2nd New Zealand Division and Crete

body.zh-Hant: 二戰爆發後，弗賴伯格再度向紐西蘭政府請纓，隨即受命指揮第2紐西蘭師，該師參與希臘、北非與義大利戰事。1941年5月在克里特島，他認為將面對海上入侵，擬定的計畫從一開始就錯了，因為德軍入侵主要是空降；文章也指出克里特陷落並非他一人之責，他得指揮裝備不良的雜牌部隊，缺少皇家空軍支援與砲兵營。克里特之役後他獲得DSO第三枚勳條，並晉升中將。
body.en: After the outbreak of the Second World War Freyberg again offered his services to the New Zealand government and was immediately appointed commander of the 2nd New Zealand Division, which fought in Greece, North Africa and Italy. In Crete in May 1941 he believed he would face an invasion from the sea and drew up a plan that was wrong from the start, since the German invasion was mainly airborne; the article adds that he was not solely responsible for the fall of Crete, having had to command a varied and badly equipped army without RAF support or the necessary artillery battalions. After Crete he added a third bar to his DSO and was promoted to lieutenant general.

heading.en: Command of the Crete garrison

body.zh-Hant: 英國官方戰史（巴克利）載，1941年4月30日韋維爾（Wavell）視察克里特，指派弗賴伯格指揮克里特部隊（Creforce），命令是「不讓敵人使用克里特的空軍基地」。澳洲戰爭紀念館稱他原想短暫停留後即回埃及與其師會合，卻被賦予守軍指揮權並奉命準備防禦；德軍入侵於5月20日清晨展開。巴克利另寫道，兩架桑德蘭飛艇到達斯法基亞，依中東司令部命令將弗賴伯格及其參謀帶走，餘下撤退由韋斯頓（Weston）負責。
body.en: Buckley's official history records that on 30 April (1941) Wavell visited Crete and appointed Freyberg to command Creforce with orders 'to deny to the enemy the use of air bases in Crete'. The Australian War Memorial says he had expected to stay only briefly before rejoining his division in Egypt but was given command of the garrison and told to prepare its defence; the German invasion began on the morning of 20 May. Buckley adds that two Sunderland flying-boats arrived at Sphakia and, on Middle East Command's orders, took off Freyberg and his staff, General Weston being left in charge of the final stage of the evacuation.
